newsitem.title: FINLAND: FISKARS SEES FAVOURABLE U.S. SALES.
newsitem.headline: FISKARS SEES FAVOURABLE U.S. SALES.

text.p: Finnish consumer goods group Fiskars Oy Ab said on Wednesday it saw the positive economic outlook in the United States creating favourable sales conditions.

"The positive economic outlook in the United States prevails, creating favourable conditions for the continued sales development of Fiskars' consumer products," Fiskars said in a statement with its first-quarter results.
"While the trend in the European marketplace is heterogenous, it meets Fiskars' growth expectations as a whole," Fiskars said.
Fiskars said that markets were also "expected to develop positively" for its Inha aluminium boat and hardware unit.
The group's Q1 profit before extraordinary items and tax rose 44 percent on the year-ago period to 59 million markka.
Fiskars did not give a full-year 1997 profit forecast. In 1996, group profit before extraordinary items and tax was 218 million markka.
